item.title: SHERIFF’S LOG
item.description: The Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office (JCSO) responded to a total of 191 calls for service from Feb. 18-24. Deputies conducted 69 traffic stops, of which four resulted in criminal (misdemeanor/felony) charges. item.title: POLICE LOG
item.description: The Port Townsend Police Department (PTPD) logged a total of 153 calls from Feb. 13-19. PTPD responded to four unwanted person calls, four alarms (including burglary and panic alarms), and six disturbance calls, while also conducting 12 welfare checks. item.title: Volunteer, deputy honored for golf course rescue
item.description: Jefferson County Sheriff’s Deputy Dean Murray and volunteer EMT Barry Luke with East Jefferson Fire Rescue (EJFR) were honored by EJFR for their “heroic actions” while responding to a call on Jan. 27. item.title: BRIEFS
item.description: Two ferries Washington State Ferries announced that two boat ferry service will return to Port Townsend on Mother’s Day, May 10, Friday through Monday. The announcement was made at the Feb. 26 meeting of the Ferry Advisory Committee. Starting in the middle of June, the service will extend to seven days a week, restoring the ferry route to full service […] The post BRIEFS first appeared on Port Townsend & Jefferson County Leader.

item.title: Marvelous moondance
item.description: The Worm Moon rises over the Cascades March 2. It signals the end of winter and the beginning of spring, when earthworms emerge as the ground thaws. This year’s Worm Moon was special because it coincided with a total lunar eclipse. The post Marvelous moondance first appeared on Port Townsend & Jefferson County Leader.

item.title: Recycling drop-off sites to shut down in Jefferson County
item.description: Jefferson County ’s unstaffed recycling sites in Kala Point, Port Hadlock and Port Ludlow will close in the coming weeks, according to Jefferson County officials, leaving county residents with the choice of paying a $20 dump fee or signing up for home pickup through Waste Connections. The closures begin March 23 for the Kala Point site at 20 Village Drive. item.description: A 68-year-old male suspect wanted by the Bellevue Police Department (BPD) in connection with a fatal hit-and-run was arrested in Port Townsend March 1. item.title: DUI arrests surge in 2025, traffic stops, drone use up
item.description: The city’s police department increased patrols in 2025, boosting traffic stops by 35% and driving a 356% spike in DUI arrests, according to its annual report presented to the city council March 2. item.title: Salty shenanigans
item.description: “Sparkle”, captained by Sean Kooman, is pulled by blustery winds during the 35th Annual Shipwrights’ Regatta in Port Townsend Bay on Feb. 28. The race began in 1992 as a simple, late-winter race for boatbuilders and has evolved into one of the most attended races of the year.
